mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate hiring slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by over 0.1pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through accelerated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates supply chain contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate output constraints reduce earnings.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the prior month signals expanding residential demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in payrolls and declining unemployment signals labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating industrial production above 105 (2017=100) indicates robust supply chain expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate output capacity.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO > 105, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
